_comment: Which of our locations each of the game's rooms is.
`fiddle/locations.toml` declares 86 rooms — every interior, every cave mouth,
every cutscene stage. This dataset has 29 locations, which are the places a
player names. The two vocabularies overlap but do not match, and only a human
can say that the game's `town` is the place the wiki calls Mistria.
Mapped here are the rooms that carry a `bug_tag`, because a bug's `tag` and a
room's `bug_tag` are the same vocabulary and that join is the only source in
the project for where an insect can be caught. Rooms are added as a consumer
needs them; an unlisted room is not an oversight, it is unmapped.
A null target is a room we deliberately do not place. Read it as 'no location
of ours is this room', never as 'not yet looked at'.

dragonsworn_glade.reason: A landmark inside the Deep Woods, not a location of ours. Its bug_tag is deep_woods, which the deep_woods room already contributes, so nothing is lost by leaving it unplaced.
